blocks.text: PESHAWAR, Pakistan—The roof of a school collapsed in Pakistan‘s northwestern city of Peshawar, killing a teacher and 32 students, mostly aged under 14, health officials said on Thursday. The death toll is revealed as residents and rescuers scrambled to pull children from the rubble. Twenty more students were taken to hospital after the collapse, which authorities blamed on “weak infrastructure.” Others in the densely populated neighborhood described a close call.
